army_rule_description: Units from your army with the Blessings of Khorne ability retain that ability and gain Slaughterers' Glory. At the start of the battle round, when making a Blessings of Khorne roll: roll four D6 instead of eight D6; you can activate only one Blessing of Khorne per battle round, instead of up to two.

detachments.detachment_rule_description: Each time a WORLD EATERS model from your army (excluding Kharn The Betrayer) is destroyed by a melee attack and it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 5+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks; it is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: Frenzied
enhancements.description: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer, and the bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Carmine Corona
enhancements.description: When the bearer destroys an enemy unit for the first time, until the end of the battle, the bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5.

stratagems.name: Blood Rite
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after a WORLD EATERS TERMINATOR, EIGHTBOUND or EXALTED EIGHTBOUND unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker that your unit or the destroyed unit was within range of at the start of the phase. That objective marker is Secured by your army.

stratagems.name: Furious Momentum
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

stratagems.name: Ruinous Rampage
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS TERMINATOR, EIGHTBOUND or EXALTED EIGHTBOUND unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit. You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

stratagems.name: Shocking Onslaught
stratagems.timing: Your Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to fire Overwatch.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is selected to fire Overwatch, it must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result; if failed, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch at your unit this phase.

allowed_units.conditional_limit: Shared pool: up to 2 total with Master of Executions
Shared pool: up to 2 total with Kharn The Betrayer

mustering_rules.description: You can include up to two of the following units: Kharn The Betrayer, Master of Executions.
Up to two of each: Eightbound (3 models), Exalted Eightbound (3 models), Chaos Terminators (5 or 10 models).
World Eaters Terminator Squad units can perform the Secure Site Tactical Manoeuvre as if they had the BATTLELINE keyword.
Kharn The Betrayer loses The Betrayer.

wargear_options.description: For every 5 models in this unit, 1 Chaos Terminator's combi-bolter can be replaced with one of the following: 1 heavy flamer or 1 reaper autocannon.
Any number of models can each have their combi-bolter replaced with 1 combi-weapon.
For every 5 models in this unit, 1 model's combi-bolter and accursed weapon can be replaced with 1 paired accursed weapons.
For every 5 models in this unit, up to 3 models can each have their accursed weapon replaced with 1 power fist.
For every 5 models in this unit, 1 model's accursed weapon can be replaced with 1 chainfist.
